naisargika_relationships._comment: Natural, permanent relationship of each planet TOWARD every other. Directional per row; the compound score combines both directions. Nodes (Rahu/Ketu) are not rashi lords here. Cross-referenced to BPHS-XREF (Naisargika data only).

scoring.rule: Let a = relation(lordA -> lordB), b = relation(lordB -> lordA). Combine the unordered pair {a,b} via compound_table. If lordA == lordB, treat as friend+friend -> 5.
